cases.prompt: design an app icon for kubetail
create an icon for this repo
draw a minimalist icon for my markdown editor as SVG
generate an app icon - symmetric glyph on a dark rounded square
make me a package icon for this OSS project
need an ios style icon for my side project, dark background pls
can u make the icon svg from icon-design/brief.md
turn concept 2 from the brief into an actual icon
simple geometric logo mark for my cli tool, dark theme
make an apple-style rounded square icon for the app
brainstorm icon ideas for my app
what symbol should represent a vpn app?
critique this icon svg - does it work at 16px?
export favicon.ico and store assets from my icon
design a set of toolbar icons for the editor UI
vectorize this PNG logo into SVG
build a full brand identity with wordmark and typography
add an icon next to the save button in the navbar
draw an svg illustration of a mountain landscape
design a banner image for the repo readme
Design an app icon for 'pulse', an uptime monitoring tool
expected_behavior: uses icon-design/brief.md if present, otherwise writes a 5-line inline brief (concept, Gestalt device, axis, palette, visual direction) before drawing
writes 2-4 candidate SVGs to icon-design/candidates/, each 1024x1024 viewBox with a background shape appropriate to the brief and platform-safe geometry
does not substitute a plain rounded <rect rx=...> for the squircle, and does not hand-tweak the generated corner path
draws the named subject rather than an arrangement of primitives - a single well-made <path> silhouette is preferred over five rects and circles composed into an abstract mark
coordinates carry at most 2 decimals and paths use absolute commands; no gradients/filters/text/image elements in the supported SVG subset
runs scripts/check_svg.py on every candidate, fixes every ERROR, and weighs the geometry WARNs against the concept rather than deforming the mark to silence them
hands off to icon-critique rather than declaring the icon finished
builds the mark from filled shapes with knockout detail rather than outlines, and does not impose shape-count or three-color budgets

cases.prompt: draw candidates for concept 1 in icon-design/brief.md
expected_behavior: reads the existing brief and respects its palette, axis, and Gestalt device without re-ideating
produces variations of the named concept only, not new concepts
candidate files follow the icon-design/candidates/<n>-<slug>.svg naming

cases.prompt: draw the approved icon with our seven-color palette and light background
expected_behavior: uses all colors needed by the approved palette without imposing a three-color maximum
allows a light background and reports contrast guidance as a warning rather than a hard failure
keeps every color as a valid hex fill or stroke within the safe SVG subset
renders candidates for critique instead of claiming color count proves quality

cases.prompt: make the app icon with a photo of my dog embedded in it
expected_behavior: declines to embed raster images (no <image> elements in the safe subset) and explains why in one or two lines
offers a stylized symmetric glyph interpretation of the subject as the compliant alternative

cases.prompt: make our icon look basically like the docker whale but for our product
expected_behavior: flags the trademark/derivative-mark risk of copying a well-known logo
proposes a distinct silhouette that serves the same metaphor instead
does not reproduce the referenced mark
